task.description: ISS-0768's own acceptance criteria (docs/issues/ISS-0768.yaml) require 'a real test creates a role for one tenant and confirms it is queryable only in that tenants own schema (not visible via a different tenants prefix, not written to public)'. This is NOT satisfied by the current test suite: SECURITY-REVIEWER's step-04 pass (see its result.issues, a non-blocking addendum from an independent concurrent pass) confirmed by direct read that test/letflow/role_registry_test.exs's setup provisions exactly ONE tenant schema per test and every existing test only asserts within that single schema -- there is no cross-tenant-isolation assertion anywhere in the file today. Add ONE (or more, your judgement) new test(s) to test/letflow/role_registry_test.exs that: (1) provisions TWO separate tenant schemas in the same test (follow the file's existing setup/insert_group! pattern in its own `setup` block and the two-tenant pattern already used elsewhere in this codebase for the same purpose -- grep test/letflow/identity/ and test/letflow/routers/identity_test.exs for an existing two-tenant-in-one-test fixture pattern rather than inventing a new one); (2) creates a role via RoleRegistry.upsert_role(name, group_id, prefix: tenant_a_schema) under tenant A; (3) asserts RoleRegistry.list_roles(prefix: tenant_b_schema) does NOT include that role (queried under tenant B's own prefix, a genuinely different schema, not merely a different filter on the same data); (4) asserts a direct query against the `public` schema (Repo.all(TenantRole, prefix: "public") or equivalent) also does not contain the role -- proving it was never written to public at all, not just correctly scoped away from tenant B. Also add or extend a case confirming RoleRegistry.list_roles(prefix: tenant_a_schema) DOES see the role -- the positive half of the assertion, not just the negative one. Do not weaken, remove, or restructure any existing test in the file. This gates SECURITY-REVIEWER's own addendum finding, so treat 'not visible via a different tenant's prefix, not written to public' as two separate, both-required assertions, not one. Branch feature/WF03-ISS0768-20260921 is checked out in worktree c:\Users\tvolo\dev\ai-dala\letflow-wf03-iss0768 -- work there, do not touch c:\Users\tvolo\dev\ai-dala\letflow. Hard rule: never push directly to main. You write test code only -- do not modify lib/letflow/identity/role_registry.ex or lib/letflow/routers/identity.ex. Do not run the tests yourself (TEST-RUNNER's job at step-08); it is fine to sanity-check compilation if you can, but the authoritative run happens later.
acceptance_criteria: New test(s) provision two genuinely separate tenant schemas within one test, not a single schema with two logical partitions
A role created under tenant A's prefix is asserted present when list_roles is called with tenant A's own prefix (positive case)
The same role is asserted ABSENT when list_roles is called with tenant B's prefix (negative case, cross-tenant)
The same role is asserted ABSENT from a direct public-schema query (negative case, not written to public)
No existing test in role_registry_test.exs weakened, removed, or restructured
Test file compiles (mix compile --warnings-as-errors on the test path, or equivalent sanity check) -- real output quoted if run
